question: Do LP2 doublets favor a rune position modulo 2–8 counted from visible sentence punctuation?
boundary_rule: Period, section mark, or semicolon ends a sentence; count subsequent rune at zero. Line breaks do not reset. Only source-derived reset rune ordinals and source text hashes are distributed here, not upstream text or code.

scan.statistic: max across moduli of chi-square/df against opportunity-weighted expectations
scan.null: For each section preserve its observed doublet count; uniformly sample eligible second-rune positions without replacement, then evaluate all seven moduli and retain the maximum. Punctuation reset positions stay fixed.
scan.plant: For each section move its observed event count to the earliest eligible positions at sentence-relative residue zero modulo seven; the detector must identify that concentration.

exclusions: Other punctuation interpretations, altered word breaks, moduli above eight, doublet identities, cipher-specific nulls and any decryption rule.
